name: Normal Equations Solver
definition: A solver approach that computes the matrix $A^T A$ and vector $A^T b$ to solve the ordinary least squares problem, noted as the fastest alternative but prone to stability issues if the matrix is ill-conditioned.
summary: The Normal Equations Solver solves overdetermined linear systems by squaring the condition number for speed, making it the fastest option for well-conditioned matrices but prone to instability when ill-conditioned.
